senses.zh: 油煎的食物；油炸；油炒；油煎

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Movable objects such as chairs, tables, and beds in buildings.

ex.en: We moved the furniture to make room for dancing.
ex.zh: 我们挪开家具，腾出地方跳舞。

ex.en: Buying second-hand furniture can lower household expenses while reducing demand for raw materials and limiting waste.
ex.zh: 购买二手家具既能降低家庭开支，也能减少原材料需求和废弃物。

col: a piece of furniture｜一件家具
tip: 不可数：一件家具说a piece of furniture。

senses.en: A liquid measure, about 4.55 litres British or 3.79 litres American

ex.en: We bought a gallon of paint for the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我们买了一加仑油漆来刷厨房。

ex.en: Comparing how far vehicles travel per gallon of fuel helps consumers assess running costs and fuel efficiency.
ex.zh: 比较车辆每消耗一加仑燃料能行驶多远，有助于消费者评估使用成本和燃油效率。

col: a gallon of petrol｜一加仑汽油
miles per gallon｜每加仑行驶英里数
tip: 英制约4.55升，美制约3.79升，注意区分。

senses.en: waste material that people throw away
something considered untrue, useless, or very poor in quality

ex.en: Please take the garbage out before it starts smelling.
ex.zh: 请在垃圾发臭之前把它拿出去。

ex.en: Cities can reduce the amount of garbage sent to landfill by improving recycling facilities and public awareness.
ex.zh: 城市可以通过改善回收设施和提高公众意识，减少运往填埋场的垃圾量。

col: take out the garbage｜把垃圾拿出去
tip: 不可数名词；常见于美式英语，英式多用rubbish。

senses.zh: 真正的；真诚的；可信赖的

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: The study of shapes, angles, sizes, and spatial relationships.

ex.en: We used colourful wooden shapes in geometry class today.
ex.zh: 今天的几何课上，我们使用了彩色的木制图形。

ex.en: Learning geometry helps students develop spatial reasoning skills that are valuable in engineering and architecture.
ex.zh: 学习几何有助于学生培养空间推理能力，这种能力在工程和建筑领域很有价值。

tip: 学科名，不可数；通常不加冠词。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A sport hitting a small ball into holes with clubs

ex.en: My grandfather plays golf with his friends every Sunday.
ex.zh: 我祖父每周日都和朋友打高尔夫球。

ex.en: Golf courses can attract tourists, but maintaining their grass may require considerable amounts of water.
ex.zh: 高尔夫球场可以吸引游客，但养护草坪可能需要大量用水。

col: a golf club｜高尔夫球杆；高尔夫俱乐部
a round of golf｜一轮高尔夫球
tip: 球类运动前通常不加冠词：play golf。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a unit of mass equal to one thousandth of a kilogram

ex.en: Add one gramme of salt to the soup.
ex.zh: 往汤里加一克盐。

ex.en: Even a single gramme of certain pollutants can harm aquatic life when released into a small pond.
ex.zh: 某些污染物即使只有一克，排入小池塘后也可能危害水生生物。

tip: gramme是英式变体；gram更常用，单位符号为g。

senses.en: Large, impressive, or splendid in appearance
Ambitious in scale or important in purpose
Very good or enjoyable

ex.en: We climbed the grand staircase beneath a sparkling chandelier.
ex.zh: 我们沿着闪亮吊灯下的豪华楼梯走了上去。

ex.en: Preserving grand public buildings can strengthen local identity, although maintenance often requires substantial government funding.
ex.zh: 保护宏伟的公共建筑可以增强地方认同感，但维护往往需要大量政府资金。

col: a grand staircase｜豪华的大楼梯
a grand opening｜隆重的开幕式
tip: grand total指全部加起来的总数。

senses.en: money given by an organisation for a particular purpose
to officially give someone something they request
to accept that something is true, often reluctantly

ex.en: A small grant helped us repair the village playground.
ex.zh: 一笔小额补助金帮助我们修好了村里的游乐场。

ex.en: Governments should provide research grants to universities developing affordable technologies for reducing household energy consumption.
ex.zh: 政府应向研发低成本家庭节能技术的大学提供研究拨款。

col: apply for a grant｜申请补助金
take something for granted｜认为某事理所当然
tip: grant sb sth可改为grant sth to sb。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Relating to pictures, drawings, or visual design.
Describing something very clearly, often with unpleasant details.
An image or diagram used to present information.

ex.en: My cousin studies graphic design and makes colourful posters.
ex.zh: 我表姐学习平面设计，还制作色彩鲜艳的海报。

ex.en: Effective graphic design can make complex health information easier for the general public to understand.
ex.zh: 有效的平面设计可以让公众更容易理解复杂的健康信息。

col: a graphic description｜生动详尽的描述
tip: graphic description常指令人不适的详细描述。

senses.en: wanting more money or possessions than one needs
wanting to eat more food than one needs

ex.en: Don't be greedy; leave some biscuits for your sister.
ex.zh: 别贪吃，给你妹妹留些饼干。

ex.en: Greedy investors may prioritise immediate profits over the long-term environmental consequences of their business decisions.
ex.zh: 贪婪的投资者可能优先考虑眼前利润，而忽视商业决策的长期环境后果。

col: a greedy investor｜贪婪的投资者
tip: 常含贬义；greedy for后接金钱、权力等所贪之物。

senses.en: Deep sadness, especially after someone you love has died

ex.en: She found comfort in friends during her grief.
ex.zh: 在悲痛中，她从朋友那里得到了慰藉。

ex.en: Schools should offer counselling to help young people manage grief after the loss of a family member.
ex.zh: 学校应提供心理辅导，帮助年轻人在失去家人后应对悲痛。

tip: 表示悲痛时通常不可数，常与失去亲人有关。

senses.en: To cook food using direct heat from above or below.
A cooking device that exposes food to direct heat.
To question someone intensely, often for a long time.

ex.en: We grilled some peppers and ate them with rice.
ex.zh: 我们烤了些甜椒，配米饭吃。

ex.en: Grilling vegetables with little oil can be a practical way to prepare healthier meals at home.
ex.zh: 用少量油烤蔬菜，是在家制作更健康餐食的一种实用方法。

col: under the grill｜在烤架热源下
grill someone about something｜就某事盘问某人
tip: 英式grill常指从上方加热；美式常指从下方烤。

senses.en: to hold something firmly
a firm hold on something
power or control over someone or something

ex.en: She gripped the railing as the boat rocked gently.
ex.zh: 船轻轻摇晃时，她紧紧抓住栏杆。

ex.en: Large companies maintain a strong grip on the market, making it difficult for smaller businesses to compete.
ex.zh: 大公司牢牢控制着市场，使小企业难以参与竞争。

col: lose your grip｜松手；失去控制
a grip on power｜对权力的掌控
tip: 过去式gripped、现在分词gripping均双写p。

senses.en: to promise something firmly or make an outcome certain
a firm promise that something will happen or be done
a promise to repair or replace a faulty product

ex.en: The shop guarantees to replace the kettle if it breaks.
ex.zh: 商店保证水壶坏了就给换新的。

ex.en: Higher education does not guarantee employment, but it can significantly improve a person's long-term career prospects.
ex.zh: 高等教育并不保证就业，但能显著改善一个人的长期职业前景。

col: guarantee access｜确保获得使用机会
tip: 可接to do或that从句；保修期内用under guarantee。

senses.en: Responsible for breaking a law or doing something wrong.
Feeling bad because you believe you have done something wrong.

ex.en: I felt guilty about forgetting my sister's birthday.
ex.zh: 我忘了姐姐的生日，感到很内疚。

ex.en: Companies found guilty of illegally dumping waste should face penalties that reflect the environmental damage caused.
ex.zh: 被裁定非法倾倒废物的公司应受到与其造成的环境损害相称的处罚。

col: find someone guilty｜裁定某人有罪
tip: guilty of接罪行；feel guilty about接内疚的事。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A small cloth used for wiping your nose or face.

ex.en: She pulled a clean handkerchief from her coat pocket.
ex.zh: 她从外套口袋里掏出一块干净的手帕。

ex.en: Using a washable handkerchief instead of disposable tissues can reduce everyday household waste.
ex.zh: 使用可清洗的手帕代替一次性纸巾，可以减少日常生活垃圾。

tip: 指擦脸、擦鼻子的手帕，一般不指头巾。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: The particular way someone forms words when writing by hand.

ex.en: Your handwriting is much neater with this new pen.
ex.zh: 你用这支新笔写的字工整多了。

ex.en: Although digital devices are common in classrooms, clear handwriting remains useful for examinations and personal communication.
ex.zh: 虽然数字设备在课堂上很常见，但清晰的手写字在考试和个人交流中仍然有用。

tip: 通常不可数；优美书法这门艺术用calligraphy。

senses.en: friendly and peaceful, without conflict
having parts that look or sound pleasing together

ex.en: Sharing the chores helps keep our home harmonious.
ex.zh: 分担家务有助于保持家庭和睦。

ex.en: Schools can promote harmonious relationships by teaching students to resolve disagreements through respectful discussion.
ex.zh: 学校可以教学生通过相互尊重的讨论解决分歧，从而促进融洽的人际关系。

tip: 既可形容人际关系融洽，也可形容色彩、声音协调。

senses.en: to emerge from an egg, or cause this to happen
an opening in a floor, ceiling, or wall
to develop a plan, often secretly

ex.en: We watched three chicks hatch on the farm yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在农场看着三只小鸡破壳而出。

ex.en: Rising temperatures can affect when turtle eggs hatch, potentially reducing the survival chances of young turtles.
ex.zh: 气温上升会影响海龟卵的孵化时间，可能降低幼龟的存活机会。

tip: 表示孵化用动词；名词常指舱口或小开口。

senses.zh: 模糊的；朦胧的；困惑的(；起步前的优势

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A plant used to flavour food or make medicines.

ex.en: She grows fresh herbs in pots beside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 她在厨房窗边的花盆里种了新鲜香草。

ex.en: Growing herbs at home can encourage healthier cooking and reduce the need for packaged seasonings.
ex.zh: 在家种植香草可以鼓励更健康的烹饪方式，并减少对包装调味料的需求。

tip: 英音h发音，美音通常不发；对应a herb和an herb。

senses.en: having an empty space inside
lacking real meaning, value, or sincere feeling
to remove the inside of something, leaving an empty space

ex.en: We found a squirrel hiding inside a hollow tree.
ex.zh: 我们发现一只松鼠躲在一棵空心树里。

ex.en: Government promises to protect endangered species will remain hollow unless they are supported by adequate funding and effective enforcement.
ex.zh: 如果没有充足资金和有效执法的支持，政府保护濒危物种的承诺就仍是空话。

tip: hollow指内部中空；empty指里面没有东西。

senses.en: A hard pointed growth on the head of some animals.
A device on a vehicle that makes a loud warning sound.
A musical instrument played by blowing into a tube.

ex.en: The goat caught its horn in the fence.
ex.zh: 那只山羊的角卡在了栅栏里。

ex.en: Frequent use of car horns contributes to noise pollution and reduces residents' quality of life.
ex.zh: 频繁使用汽车喇叭会造成噪声污染，降低居民的生活质量。

tip: 动物的角和车辆喇叭都用horn，均为可数名词。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Not believing or acting as though you are better than others.
Simple or low in social position, wealth, or importance.
To make someone feel less proud or important.

ex.en: Despite winning the prize, she remained humble and thanked everyone.
ex.zh: 尽管获了奖，她依然谦逊，并向所有人表示感谢。

ex.en: Effective leaders remain humble enough to acknowledge mistakes and learn from colleagues with different backgrounds and experiences.
ex.zh: 优秀的领导者保持谦逊，愿意承认错误，并向背景和经历不同的同事学习。

col: in my humble opinion｜依我拙见
tip: 谦逊是humble；不要与“羞辱”humiliate混淆。

senses.en: A small, simple building, often made of wood or grass.

ex.en: We sheltered from the rain in a wooden hut.
ex.zh: 我们躲进一间木屋避雨。

ex.en: Mountain huts provide essential shelter for hikers, but their construction should minimise damage to fragile ecosystems.
ex.zh: 山间小屋为徒步者提供必要的庇护，但建造时应尽量减少对脆弱生态系统的破坏。

tip: hut强调简小朴素，通常不是设施齐全的住宅。

senses.en: the lightest chemical element, a colourless gas that burns easily

ex.en: Our science teacher showed us how hydrogen burns.
ex.zh: 科学老师向我们演示了氢气如何燃烧。

ex.en: Hydrogen produced using renewable electricity could help reduce emissions from industries that currently depend on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 利用可再生电力生产的氢气，可帮助目前依赖化石燃料的行业减少排放。

tip: hydrogen是不可数名词，表示化学元素氢或氢气。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: widely recognised as representing a place, style, or idea

ex.en: We stopped to photograph the city's iconic stone bridge.
ex.zh: 我们停下来拍摄这座城市标志性的石桥。

ex.en: Preserving iconic buildings can strengthen cultural identity, although maintenance costs may place pressure on public budgets.
ex.zh: 保护标志性建筑可以增强文化认同，但维护费用可能给公共预算带来压力。

tip: 不只是“著名”，还强调鲜明的代表性和辨识度。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: to put a plan or decision into action
a tool used for a particular task

ex.en: Our team will implement the new schedule next week.
ex.zh: 我们团队下周将实行新的时间表。

ex.en: Governments should implement policies that make public transport more affordable for people on low incomes.
ex.zh: 政府应实施相关政策，让低收入人群更负担得起公共交通。

tip: 动词重音在首音节；名词末音节读/mənt/。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a unit of length equal to 2.54 centimetres
to move very slowly over a short distance

ex.en: The shelf is an inch wider than the cupboard.
ex.zh: 这个架子比橱柜宽一英寸。

ex.en: During rush hour, buses inch through crowded streets, making public transport less attractive to commuters.
ex.zh: 高峰时段，公交车在拥挤的街道上缓慢行驶，降低了公共交通对通勤者的吸引力。

tip: 英寸符号为″；作动词表示一点点移动。

senses.en: Able to strongly affect people's opinions, decisions, or actions.

ex.en: Her grandfather was an influential teacher in their village.
ex.zh: 她的祖父曾是村里一位很有影响力的教师。

ex.en: Scientific advisers can be influential in shaping government policies on public health and environmental protection.
ex.zh: 科学顾问可以在制定公共卫生和环境保护政策方面发挥重要影响。

col: influential in shaping policy｜对政策制定有影响力
tip: 常用be influential in doing，表示对某事有影响。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Not responsible for a crime or wrongdoing.
Lacking experience or knowledge of unpleasant aspects of life.
Not intended to hurt, offend, or cause trouble.

ex.en: The broken vase was not his fault; he was innocent.
ex.zh: 花瓶打碎不是他的错，他是无辜的。

ex.en: A fair legal system must protect innocent people while ensuring that those responsible for crimes face justice.
ex.zh: 公平的法律制度必须保护无辜者，同时确保犯罪者受到法律制裁。

col: innocent of a crime｜未犯某罪
tip: 表示未犯某罪用innocent of，不用innocent from。

senses.en: information or resources supplied to a system or process
ideas or advice contributed to a discussion or task
to enter information into a computer or other device

ex.en: Please input your address before choosing a delivery time.
ex.zh: 请选择配送时间前先输入地址。

ex.en: Community input can help planners design public spaces that better reflect local needs.
ex.zh: 居民的意见可以帮助规划者设计出更符合当地需求的公共空间。

tip: 作动词时，过去式可用 input 或 inputted。

senses.en: A careful examination to check condition, quality, or safety.

ex.en: The mechanic found a loose cable during the inspection.
ex.zh: 机械师在检查时发现了一根松动的电缆。

ex.en: Regular inspection of public buildings can identify structural problems before they become serious safety risks.
ex.zh: 定期检查公共建筑可以在结构问题构成严重安全风险之前发现它们。

col: carry out an inspection｜进行检查
tip: inspection指检查过程；检查某物用of连接。

senses.en: the quality of being honest and following strong moral principles
the condition of being whole, undamaged, or unchanged

ex.en: She showed integrity by returning the money she found.
ex.zh: 她归还了捡到的钱，体现了诚实正直的品质。

ex.en: Independent inspections help maintain the structural integrity of bridges and protect the public from preventable accidents.
ex.zh: 独立检查有助于保持桥梁结构的完整性，保护公众免受本可避免的事故伤害。

tip: 不可数名词；既指人的正直，也指结构的完整性。

senses.en: Between basic and advanced levels, or between two stages.
A learner whose skills are between beginner and advanced levels.

ex.en: This swimming class is suitable for intermediate learners.
ex.zh: 这门游泳课适合中级学员。

ex.en: Intermediate language courses should balance grammar instruction with opportunities for meaningful communication outside the classroom.
ex.zh: 中级语言课程应兼顾语法教学与课堂外有实际意义的交流机会。

tip: 常指介于beginner与advanced之间的水平。

senses.en: Money put into something with the aim of future profit.
Time or effort spent on something expected to bring benefits.

ex.en: Buying better tools was a good investment for our bakery.
ex.zh: 购买更好的工具对我们面包店来说是一笔不错的投资。

ex.en: Greater public investment in renewable energy could create jobs while reducing dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 加大对可再生能源的公共投资可以创造就业机会，同时减少对化石燃料的依赖。

col: investment in infrastructure｜基础设施投资
an investment of time｜时间投入
tip: 通常搭配in；表示投资行为时常作不可数名词。

senses.en: A sweet spread made by cooking fruit with sugar.
A situation where movement stops because things are packed together.
To become stuck, or force something into a tight space.

ex.en: I spread strawberry jam on my toast this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我在吐司上抹了草莓酱。

ex.en: Frequent traffic jams increase air pollution and make daily journeys more stressful for urban residents.
ex.zh: 频繁的交通拥堵加剧空气污染，也让城市居民的日常出行更加令人焦虑。

col: jam something into｜把某物硬塞进
tip: 果酱通常不可数；一次交通堵塞用a traffic jam。

senses.en: either bone structure in the mouth that holds the teeth

ex.en: My jaw felt sore after chewing the hard bread.
ex.zh: 嚼完那块硬面包后，我的下颌有些酸痛。

ex.en: Protective equipment can reduce the risk of jaw injuries among people who participate in contact sports.
ex.zh: 防护装备可以降低接触性运动参与者颌部受伤的风险。

tip: jaw指颌骨或颌部；chin仅指脸部最下方的下巴。

senses.en: Shared, owned, or done by two or more people or groups.
A place where bones or separate parts meet.

ex.en: Buying the sofa was a joint decision with my flatmate.
ex.zh: 买这张沙发是我和室友共同作出的决定。

ex.en: Joint research projects allow universities to share resources and address environmental problems more effectively.
ex.zh: 联合研究项目使大学能够共享资源，更有效地应对环境问题。

tip: joint作形容词指共同参与；作名词可指关节。

senses.zh: 震动；摇晃；颠簸；使）震动；摇晃

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A tropical forest with thick, closely growing plants and trees
A confusing or dangerous situation involving fierce competition

ex.en: Thick vines hung above the narrow jungle path.
ex.zh: 茂密的藤蔓垂在狭窄的丛林小路上方。

ex.en: Clearing jungle for agriculture destroys wildlife habitats and can reduce biodiversity across an entire region.
ex.zh: 清除热带丛林以开辟农田会破坏野生动物栖息地，并可能降低整个地区的生物多样性。

tip: 通常指热带的茂密丛林；forest泛指森林。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A container with a handle and spout for boiling water.

ex.en: Put the kettle on while I find the cups.
ex.zh: 你先烧水，我来找杯子。

ex.en: Boiling only the water needed in a kettle can reduce household electricity consumption over time.
ex.zh: 每次只烧所需的水，长期下来可以减少家庭用电量。

tip: kettle 用来烧水，teapot 用来泡茶。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: to make clothing or fabric by looping yarn with needles
to join closely together or heal into one piece

ex.en: My grandfather knitted a warm scarf for me.
ex.zh: 我爷爷给我织了一条暖和的围巾。

ex.en: Community groups that knit blankets for local shelters combine practical support with opportunities for social interaction.
ex.zh: 为当地收容所编织毯子的社区团体，将实际援助与社交机会结合起来。

tip: k不发音；过去式和过去分词可用knitted或knit。

senses.en: during the recent period up to the present

ex.en: Have you been sleeping well lately, or feeling tired?
ex.zh: 你最近睡得好吗，还是觉得疲倦？

ex.en: Lately, researchers have paid greater attention to the relationship between access to green spaces and mental health.
ex.zh: 近来，研究人员更加关注绿地可及性与心理健康之间的关系。

tip: 常与现在完成时连用；不要与表示迟到的late混淆。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A group of sports teams that regularly compete against one another.
An association of people or groups sharing a common purpose.
A level of quality, ability, or achievement.

ex.en: Our team finished top of the league this season.
ex.zh: 我们队本赛季在联赛中排名第一。

ex.en: A local sports league can strengthen community ties by bringing together players from different social backgrounds.
ex.zh: 地方体育联赛可以让不同社会背景的球员聚在一起，从而加强社区联系。

col: top of the league｜联赛榜首
in a different league｜远高于一般水平
out of my league｜超出我的能力范围
tip: in a different league常指水平远胜一筹。

senses.en: animal skin treated for making clothes, bags, and other goods

ex.en: Her old leather bag still feels soft and smooth.
ex.zh: 她的旧皮包摸起来仍然柔软光滑。

ex.en: Some consumers avoid leather products because they are concerned about animal welfare and the environmental impact of production.
ex.zh: 一些消费者避免购买皮革制品，因为他们关心动物福利以及生产对环境的影响。

tip: 通常不可数；leather jacket中名词作定语。

senses.zh: 吃剩的；残留的；吃剩的食物；遗留物

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A bar used to move something or control a machine
To move something using a bar as a lever
A means of influencing people or changing a situation

ex.en: Pull this lever to raise the seat a little.
ex.zh: 拉这个操纵杆，把座位稍微升高一点。

ex.en: Tax policy can serve as a powerful lever for encouraging businesses to invest in cleaner technologies.
ex.zh: 税收政策可以成为鼓励企业投资更清洁技术的有力手段。

col: a lever for change｜推动变革的手段
tip: 英式首音节读/liː/，美式通常读/lev/。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: to give official permission for an activity
an official document permitting an activity or ownership

ex.en: You need a license to drive on public roads.
ex.zh: 你需要有驾驶执照才能在公共道路上开车。

ex.en: Authorities should license childcare providers carefully to ensure that facilities meet appropriate safety and quality standards.
ex.zh: 主管部门应审慎审批托育机构的经营许可，确保设施符合相应的安全和质量标准。

col: license someone to do something｜许可某人做某事
apply for a license｜申请许可证
tip: 英式名词写 licence、动词写 license；美式均用 license。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: a thick piece of wood cut from a tree
a detailed record of events or activities
to record information about events, activities, or measurements

ex.en: We sat on a fallen log beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们坐在湖边一段倒下的树干上。

ex.en: Researchers log changes in water temperature to assess how climate change affects freshwater ecosystems over time.
ex.zh: 研究人员记录水温变化，以评估气候变化长期以来对淡水生态系统的影响。

tip: 动词过去式为logged；log in表示登录。

senses.en: Continuing to support someone or something, even during difficulties.

ex.en: Our loyal dog waits by the door every evening.
ex.zh: 我们忠实的狗每天傍晚都在门边等候。

ex.en: Companies that treat their employees fairly are more likely to retain a loyal and productive workforce.
ex.zh: 公平对待员工的公司更有可能留住忠诚且高效的员工队伍。

tip: 表示忠于某人或组织，用loyal to，不用loyal with。

senses.en: letters and parcels sent or delivered through a postal service
to send a letter or parcel through a postal service

ex.en: The mail arrived just as we finished breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们刚吃完早饭，邮件就到了。

ex.en: Although digital communication is widespread, many rural residents still depend on mail for essential documents.
ex.zh: 尽管数字通信已很普及，许多农村居民仍依赖邮政收取重要文件。

col: send by mail｜通过邮政寄送
tip: mail作“邮件”通常不可数；英式日常也常用post。

senses.en: A warm-blooded animal whose females produce milk for their young.

ex.en: A dolphin is a mammal, even though it lives underwater.
ex.zh: 海豚虽然生活在水下，却是哺乳动物。

ex.en: Protecting marine mammals requires international cooperation because these animals often migrate across the waters of several countries.
ex.zh: 保护海洋哺乳动物需要国际合作，因为这些动物经常跨越多个国家的水域迁徙。

tip: 鲸和海豚也是哺乳动物；不能按栖息地判断。

senses.zh: 有人控制的；需人操纵的

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。

senses.en: Relating to the sea or organisms living in it
Relating to ships and transport by sea
A soldier trained to serve on land and at sea

ex.en: We watched a documentary about marine life last night.
ex.zh: 我们昨晚看了一部关于海洋生物的纪录片。

ex.en: Plastic pollution threatens marine ecosystems and reduces the income of communities that depend on fishing.
ex.zh: 塑料污染威胁海洋生态系统，并减少依靠捕鱼为生的社区的收入。

tip: marine侧重海洋；海军的通常用naval。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: being the greatest amount or level possible or allowed
the greatest amount or level possible or allowed

ex.en: This lift has a maximum capacity of eight people.
ex.zh: 这部电梯最多可容纳八人。

ex.en: Governments should set maximum limits on industrial emissions to protect public health and improve air quality.
ex.zh: 政府应对工业排放设定上限，以保护公众健康并改善空气质量。

tip: a maximum of表示“最多”；反义词是minimum。

senses.en: During the same time or while something else is happening.

ex.en: The soup is simmering; meanwhile, I will prepare dessert.
ex.zh: 汤正在慢炖；趁这会儿，我来准备甜点。

ex.en: New railway lines may take years to complete; meanwhile, cities should improve existing bus services.
ex.zh: 新铁路线可能需要多年才能建成；在此期间，城市应改善现有的公交服务。

tip: 连接两个完整句子时，前面用句号或分号。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.zh: 商人；批发商；海上货运的

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Kindness shown by choosing not to punish or harm someone.

ex.en: The teacher showed mercy and accepted my late homework.
ex.zh: 老师宽容地收下了我迟交的作业。

ex.en: A fair justice system should balance appropriate punishment with mercy towards people who genuinely seek to change.
ex.zh: 公平的司法制度应在适当惩罚与宽待真心寻求改变的人之间取得平衡。

col: at the mercy of｜任由……摆布
tip: at the mercy of意为“任由……摆布”。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: The movement of people to live in another place.
The regular movement of animals between regions, often with the seasons.
The transfer of data or software to another computer system.

ex.en: We watched the birds during their annual autumn migration.
ex.zh: 我们观察了正在进行一年一度秋季迁徙的鸟儿。

ex.en: Migration from rural areas to cities can increase pressure on housing while providing workers for expanding industries.
ex.zh: 农村人口向城市迁移可能加大住房压力，同时为不断扩张的行业提供劳动力。

col: rural-to-urban migration｜农村向城市的人口迁移
tip: migration泛指迁移；immigration侧重迁入。

senses.en: A senior government official responsible for a particular area.
A religious leader in certain Christian churches.
To care for someone or attend to their needs.

ex.en: The minister visited our school to meet the teachers.
ex.zh: 部长来到我们学校与教师们见面。

ex.en: Trained volunteers minister to the needs of older residents who lack access to regular medical care.
ex.zh: 受过培训的志愿者照料无法定期获得医疗服务的老年居民。

col: minister to someone's needs｜照顾某人的需要
tip: 动词义较正式，常用minister to表示照料。

senses.en: Very unhappy or uncomfortable
Extremely unpleasant or of very poor quality

ex.en: I felt miserable when rain ruined our picnic plans.
ex.zh: 大雨毁了我们的野餐计划，让我很难过。

ex.en: Overcrowded housing can create miserable living conditions and negatively affect residents' physical and mental health.
ex.zh: 住房过度拥挤会造成恶劣的生活条件，并损害居民的身心健康。

tip: 既可形容人的心情，也可形容天气或生活条件。

senses.zh: 嘲鸫（美洲鸣禽，能模仿别种鸟的鸣叫

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Neither very large nor very small in amount or degree
Avoiding extreme political views or actions
To become or make something less extreme or intense

ex.en: A moderate amount of exercise helps me sleep better.
ex.zh: 适量运动能让我睡得更好。

ex.en: Moderate increases in housing density could accommodate urban growth without placing excessive pressure on local infrastructure.
ex.zh: 适度提高住房密度可以满足城市发展的需求，同时避免给当地基础设施造成过大压力。

col: moderate your expectations｜适当降低期望
tip: 形容词末尾读/ət/，动词末尾读/eɪt/。

senses.en: Happening, produced, or paid once every month.
Once every month.
A magazine published once every month.

ex.en: My monthly bus pass fits neatly inside my wallet.
ex.zh: 我的公交月票正好能放进钱包里。

ex.en: Monthly payments can make essential services more affordable, but households should monitor their total spending carefully.
ex.zh: 按月付款可以减轻基本服务的支付压力，但家庭仍应仔细监控总支出。

tip: monthly既可作形容词，也可作副词。

senses.en: A structure built to honour a person or important event.
An old structure valued for its historical importance.

ex.en: We left flowers beside the monument in the town square.
ex.zh: 我们把鲜花放在镇广场的纪念碑旁。

ex.en: Protecting ancient monuments can strengthen cultural identity while attracting visitors and supporting employment in local communities.
ex.zh: 保护古迹既能增强文化认同，又能吸引游客，为当地社区创造就业机会。

tip: 纪念某人或某事用a monument to。

senses.en: the way someone feels at a particular time
the feeling that a place, event, or artwork creates

ex.en: A short walk usually puts me in a better mood.
ex.zh: 散一小会儿步通常就能让我的心情好一些。

ex.en: Access to green spaces can improve residents' mood and encourage more positive interactions within urban communities.
ex.zh: 能够享用绿地可以改善居民心情，促进城市社区内更积极的互动。

col: in the mood for｜有心情做……
tip: in the mood for后接名词；接动词用to do。

senses.en: a reason for doing something

ex.en: Her motive for joining was simply to make friends.
ex.zh: 她加入的动机只是想交朋友。

ex.en: Financial security is a major motive for many graduates who choose careers in established companies.
ex.zh: 经济保障是许多毕业生选择到成熟企业就业的主要动机。

col: motive for doing something｜做某事的动机
tip: motive强调行动背后的原因，常接for。

senses.en: A machine that supplies power to move or operate something.
Relating to vehicles powered by engines or motors.
Relating to muscles, movement, or the nerves controlling them.

ex.en: The fan stopped because its motor had become too hot.
ex.zh: 风扇停了，因为它的电动机过热了。

ex.en: Activities such as drawing and building with blocks help young children develop fine motor skills.
ex.zh: 画画和搭积木等活动有助于幼儿发展精细动作技能。

col: fine motor skills｜精细动作技能
tip: motor skills指身体动作技能，与汽车无关。

senses.en: Soft, wet earth made when soil mixes with water.

ex.en: Our boots were covered in mud after the walk.
ex.zh: 散步回来后，我们的靴子上沾满了泥。

ex.en: Heavy rainfall can turn unpaved roads into mud, making rural communities difficult to reach.
ex.zh: 强降雨会使未铺装的道路变得泥泞，导致农村社区交通不便。

col: get stuck in the mud｜陷在泥里
tip: mud通常不可数；形容泥泞用muddy。

senses.en: the crime of deliberately and unlawfully killing someone
to deliberately and unlawfully kill someone

ex.en: We watched a film about a detective investigating a murder.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部讲述侦探调查谋杀案的电影。

ex.en: Accurate forensic evidence plays a crucial role in solving murder cases and preventing wrongful convictions.
ex.zh: 准确的法医证据对侦破谋杀案和防止误判起着关键作用。

col: be charged with murder｜被控谋杀
tip: murder强调非法且故意杀人；kill含义更广。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: The hard covering at the end of a finger or toe.
A thin pointed metal piece used to fasten materials together.
To attach something using nails.

ex.en: I cut my nails before my piano lesson.
ex.zh: 我在上钢琴课前剪了指甲。

ex.en: Teaching children to keep their nails clean can help establish healthy personal hygiene habits early.
ex.zh: 教孩子保持指甲清洁，有助于他们尽早养成良好的个人卫生习惯。

tip: 既指指甲也指钉子；作动词表示用钉子固定。

senses.zh: 领航员；（飞机、船舶等上的）航行者

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: the armed force that operates mainly at sea
a very dark blue colour
having a very dark blue colour

ex.en: My uncle joined the navy after leaving school.
ex.zh: 我叔叔毕业后加入了海军。

ex.en: The navy can support coastal communities by delivering emergency supplies after severe storms damage local roads.
ex.zh: 强风暴破坏当地道路后，海军可以运送应急物资，支援沿海社区。

col: serve in the navy｜在海军服役
tip: navy指海军整体；具体的一艘军舰用warship。

senses.en: Discuss terms with others to reach an agreement.
Successfully move past an obstacle or along a difficult route.

ex.en: We negotiated a lower price for the secondhand sofa.
ex.zh: 我们经过协商，以更低的价格买下了那张二手沙发。

ex.en: Governments must negotiate fair trade agreements that protect workers while encouraging international investment and economic growth.
ex.zh: 各国政府必须协商达成公平的贸易协定，在保护劳动者的同时促进国际投资和经济增长。

col: negotiate an agreement｜协商达成协议
negotiate a bend｜顺利通过弯道
tip: 与某人谈判用with；也可直接接agreement。

senses.en: A son of your sibling or your spouse's sibling.

ex.en: My nephew proudly showed me his new bicycle.
ex.zh: 我的侄子自豪地给我看他的新自行车。

ex.en: Looking after a nephew or niece can help young adults understand the responsibilities of raising children.
ex.zh: 照顾侄子或侄女可以帮助年轻人理解养育孩子的责任。

col: young nephew｜年幼的侄子或外甥
tip: nephew 指男性晚辈；女性对应词是 niece。

senses.en: A structure animals build to hold eggs or raise their young.
Build or occupy a nest.

ex.en: A small bird carried twigs to its nest.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟把细树枝衔回巢里。

ex.en: Protecting trees where rare birds nest is essential for maintaining biodiversity in areas affected by urban development.
ex.zh: 在受城市开发影响的地区，保护珍稀鸟类筑巢的树木对维持生物多样性至关重要。

tip: nest既可作名词鸟巢，也可作动词筑巢。

senses.en: A daughter of your sibling or your spouse's sibling.

ex.en: My niece brought her new puppy to our picnic.
ex.zh: 我的侄女带着她新养的小狗来参加我们的野餐。

ex.en: Flexible working hours can help adults care for relatives, including a young niece or nephew.
ex.zh: 弹性工作时间可以帮助成年人照顾亲属，包括年幼的侄女或侄子。

col: young niece｜年幼的侄女或外甥女
nieces and nephews｜侄子侄女及外甥外甥女
tip: niece指女性晚辈，nephew指男性晚辈。

senses.en: showing strong moral qualities and concern for others
belonging to a family with high inherited social rank
a person belonging to a high-ranking hereditary social class

ex.en: Helping strangers without expecting rewards is a noble act.
ex.zh: 帮助陌生人而不求回报是一种高尚的行为。

ex.en: Although reducing poverty is a noble goal, effective policies require sustained funding and careful evaluation.
ex.zh: 虽然减贫是崇高的目标，但有效的政策需要持续的资金支持和审慎的评估。

tip: 表示“高尚的”时强调品德，而非社会地位。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Relating to atomic nuclei or the energy they release.
Relating to the nucleus of a cell.

ex.en: My cousin works at a nearby nuclear power station.
ex.zh: 我表亲在附近的一座核电站工作。

ex.en: Nuclear energy can provide reliable electricity, but managing radioactive waste remains a major challenge.
ex.zh: 核能可以提供可靠的电力，但处理放射性废物仍是一大挑战。

tip: nuclear可指原子核或细胞核，依语境判断。

senses.en: a place where young children are cared for
a place where young plants are grown for sale
a room in a home for a baby or young child

ex.en: My daughter painted a bright yellow duck at nursery.
ex.zh: 我女儿在幼儿园画了一只鲜黄色的鸭子。

ex.en: Affordable nursery places allow more parents to return to work while their children receive professional care.
ex.zh: 价格可负担的托幼名额能让更多父母重返职场，同时让孩子得到专业照护。

tip: 英式英语中at nursery常指在托儿所。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.zh: 使适应；使面对；确定方向

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: to begin or come from a particular place or situation
to create or introduce something new

ex.en: This recipe originated in a small coastal village.
ex.zh: 这道菜的做法起源于一个沿海小村庄。

ex.en: Many environmental problems originate from patterns of consumption rather than a lack of available technology.
ex.zh: 许多环境问题源于消费模式，而非缺乏可用技术。

tip: 表示起源常接in或from；不要误当作航行出发。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: The speed at which someone moves or something happens
A single step taken when walking
To walk repeatedly back and forth, often when worried

ex.en: We slowed our pace so Grandma could catch up.
ex.zh: 我们放慢脚步，好让奶奶跟上。

ex.en: The rapid pace of technological change requires workers to update their skills throughout their careers.
ex.zh: 技术变革的快速步伐要求劳动者在整个职业生涯中不断更新技能。

col: at your own pace｜按自己的节奏
the pace of change｜变化的速度
pace up and down｜来回踱步
tip: 按某种速度用at a ... pace；keep pace with指跟上。

senses.en: a group chosen to discuss, judge, or advise
a flat piece forming part of a surface
a surface containing controls or instruments

ex.en: The panel listened carefully as each student presented an idea.
ex.zh: 每位学生陈述想法时，评审小组都认真倾听。

ex.en: An independent panel should assess the environmental impact of major construction projects before work begins.
ex.zh: 独立专家组应在重大建设项目开工前评估其环境影响。

col: a panel of experts｜专家小组
tip: 专家组用a panel of experts；成员称panellist。

senses.en: an object wrapped for sending by post or delivery
a piece of land considered as a single unit
to wrap something, or divide it into portions for distribution

ex.en: A small parcel arrived for you this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上有个寄给你的小包裹到了。

ex.en: The growing volume of parcel deliveries has encouraged cities to explore cleaner transport options for local distribution.
ex.zh: 包裹配送量不断增长，促使城市探索更环保的本地配送方式。

col: a parcel of land｜一块土地
tip: 包裹在英式英语中常用parcel，美式英语更常用package。

senses.en: The act of leaving a vehicle in a particular place.
Space or facilities where vehicles can be left.

ex.en: Parking is difficult on this narrow street after sunset.
ex.zh: 日落后，在这条狭窄的街道上停车很困难。

ex.en: Reducing free parking in city centres may encourage commuters to use public transport more frequently.
ex.zh: 减少市中心的免费停车位可能促使通勤者更频繁地使用公共交通。

tip: 名词通常不可数；一个停车位说a parking space。

senses.en: Someone who takes part in an activity or event.

ex.en: Each participant brought a homemade dish to the cooking workshop.
ex.zh: 每位参与者都带了一道自制菜来参加烹饪工作坊。

ex.en: Every participant in the research project gave informed consent before sharing information about their daily exercise habits.
ex.zh: 研究项目的每位参与者都在知情同意后，才分享了自己的日常锻炼习惯信息。

col: participant in a study｜研究参与者
tip: 常作名词；表示某活动的参与者用participant in。

senses.en: Lasting indefinitely rather than for a limited time.
Employed without a fixed end date.

ex.en: The hot pan left a permanent mark on the table.
ex.zh: 滚烫的锅在桌上留下了无法去除的印痕。

ex.en: Investment in flood prevention can reduce the risk of permanent damage to homes and public infrastructure.
ex.zh: 投资防洪措施可以降低住房和公共基础设施遭受永久性损害的风险。

tip: permanent job指无固定结束日期的工作，不保证终身任职。

senses.zh: 毅力；韧性；不屈不挠的精神

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Expecting bad results or focusing on possible problems.

ex.en: He felt pessimistic about the picnic when clouds gathered.
ex.zh: 乌云聚拢时，他觉得野餐恐怕办不成了。

ex.en: Young people may become pessimistic about their career prospects when stable employment opportunities remain limited.
ex.zh: 当稳定的就业机会持续不足时，年轻人可能对职业前景感到悲观。

col: pessimistic about the future｜对未来悲观
tip: 常用be pessimistic about；反义词是optimistic。

senses.en: A distinct period in a process of change or development.
One of the changing shapes of the moon as seen.
To introduce or remove something gradually in planned stages.

ex.en: The kitchen repairs have entered their final phase.
ex.zh: 厨房维修已进入最后阶段。

ex.en: During the initial phase of urban development, planners should prioritise affordable housing and reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 在城市发展的初期阶段，规划者应优先考虑可负担住房和可靠的公共交通。

col: a phase of development｜发展阶段
tip: phase in指逐步引入，phase out指逐步淘汰。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: An area of ground used for outdoor team sports.
How high or low a sound is.
Present an idea or product to persuade someone to accept it.

ex.en: The players ran onto the pitch despite the rain.
ex.zh: 尽管下着雨，球员们还是跑进了球场。

ex.en: Young entrepreneurs often pitch their business ideas to investors who can provide funding and practical guidance.
ex.zh: 年轻创业者经常向能够提供资金和实用指导的投资者推介商业构想。

tip: 球场义常见于英式英语；pitch a tent意为搭帐篷。

senses.en: The area beside railway tracks where passengers board trains.
A raised surface where people can stand or perform.
A service or system for sharing information or doing activities.

ex.en: We waited on the platform as the train approached.
ex.zh: 火车驶近时，我们正在站台上等候。

ex.en: Online learning platforms allow students in remote areas to access courses that are unavailable locally.
ex.zh: 在线学习平台让偏远地区的学生能够学习当地没有开设的课程。

col: a platform for debate｜辩论的平台
tip: 在站台上用on the platform，不用in。

senses.en: A device connecting electrical equipment to a power socket.
An object fitted into a hole to stop liquid escaping.
To fill or block a hole or gap.

ex.en: Pull the plug out before you clean the toaster.
ex.zh: 清洁烤面包机前，先拔掉插头。

ex.en: Households can reduce some unnecessary electricity consumption by removing plugs from sockets when appliances are not in use.
ex.zh: 家电不用时拔掉插头，家庭就能减少一些不必要的耗电。

col: pull out the plug｜拔出插头
plug something in｜给某物接通电源
tip: 插头是plug，插座是socket；plug in表示插电。

senses.en: an agreed plan or rule guiding decisions and actions
a contract describing the insurance cover someone has bought

ex.en: Our school has a policy of serving fresh fruit daily.
ex.zh: 我们学校规定每天供应新鲜水果。

ex.en: An effective housing policy should address both rising rents and the shortage of affordable homes.
ex.zh: 有效的住房政策应同时应对租金上涨和可负担住房短缺的问题。

tip: policy是政策或保险单；politics指政治。

senses.en: To rub a surface until it becomes smooth and shiny.
To improve something by making small, careful changes.
A substance used to make a surface smooth and shiny.

ex.en: I polish my shoes before every important meeting.
ex.zh: 每次参加重要会议前，我都会把鞋擦亮。

ex.en: University students should learn to polish their writing by removing unnecessary words and organising arguments logically.
ex.zh: 大学生应学会通过删去多余词语和有条理地组织论点来润色文章。

tip: 小写polish指擦亮；大写Polish指波兰的，读音不同。

senses.en: relating to government, public power, or political parties

ex.en: We often discuss political issues around the dinner table.
ex.zh: 我们经常在餐桌上讨论政治问题。

ex.en: Political stability can encourage long-term investment and help governments maintain essential public services.
ex.zh: 政治稳定能够鼓励长期投资，并帮助政府维持必要的公共服务。

tip: political是形容词；politics指政治，politician指政治家。

senses.en: activities concerning government and how a country is run
a person's beliefs about government and public affairs

ex.en: My uncle loves discussing politics over dinner with friends.
ex.zh: 我叔叔喜欢在晚餐时和朋友们讨论政治。

ex.en: Greater involvement in politics can help young people influence decisions that affect their future.
ex.zh: 更多地参与政治能帮助年轻人影响关乎自身未来的决策。

tip: 指政治活动时通常配单数谓语；政治立场可配复数。

senses.en: a small area of still water surrounded by land

ex.en: A green frog jumped into the pond beside our house.
ex.zh: 一只绿青蛙跳进了我们屋旁的池塘。

ex.en: Creating ponds in urban parks can provide valuable habitats for amphibians and increase local biodiversity.
ex.zh: 在城市公园中建造池塘可以为两栖动物提供宝贵的栖息地，并增加当地的生物多样性。

tip: pond通常比lake小；可指天然或人工池塘。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: To speak to a god to ask, thank, or worship.
To hope very strongly that something will happen.

ex.en: They gather quietly each morning to pray for peace.
ex.zh: 他们每天早晨静静地聚在一起，为和平祈祷。

ex.en: Providing quiet spaces allows people of different faiths to pray while studying or working on campus.
ex.zh: 提供安静的空间能让不同信仰的人在校园学习或工作期间祈祷。

tip: pray to 接祈祷对象，pray for 接所求之事。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Exactly and accurately, without any difference or error.
Used to emphasize that something is exactly the case.

ex.en: The carpenter cut each shelf precisely to fit the cupboard.
ex.zh: 木匠精确裁切了每块搁板，使其与柜子吻合。

ex.en: Researchers must measure changes in sea level precisely to assess the long-term effects of climate change.
ex.zh: 研究人员必须精确测量海平面的变化，以评估气候变化的长期影响。

tip: precisely because表示“正是因为”，强调原因。

senses.en: An unfair opinion formed without enough knowledge or experience.
To unfairly influence someone's judgement or harm their chances.

ex.en: Her neighbours welcomed her warmly, without any prejudice.
ex.zh: 邻居们热情地欢迎她，没有任何偏见。

ex.en: Schools can challenge prejudice by encouraging students to learn about cultures different from their own.
ex.zh: 学校可以鼓励学生了解不同于自身的文化，从而消除偏见。

col: prejudice someone's chances｜损害某人的机会
tip: 表示对某群体的偏见，常用prejudice against。

senses.zh: 总理；首相；地区政府首脑
senses.en: The head of a national or regional government.
Considered the best or most important of its kind.

ex.en: The premier visited our village after the river flooded.
ex.zh: 河水泛滥后，总理到我们村视察。

ex.en: The premier announced new measures to improve access to affordable housing in rapidly growing cities.
ex.zh: 总理宣布了新措施，以改善快速发展城市中居民获得可负担住房的机会。

col: the newly elected premier｜新当选的政府首脑
a premier research institution｜顶尖研究机构
tip: premier可指政府首脑；premiere指首映或首演。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Very basic, without advanced features or modern comforts.
Belonging to an early stage of development.

ex.en: The campsite had only a primitive outdoor cooking area.
ex.zh: 营地只有一个简陋的户外烹饪区。

ex.en: Although these tools appear primitive, they reveal considerable skill in selecting and shaping locally available materials.
ex.zh: 尽管这些工具看起来粗糙，却体现了选择和加工当地材料的高超技艺。

col: primitive life forms｜原始生命形式
tip: 形容设施可指简陋；用于当代民族或文化可能含贬义。

senses.en: something considered more important than other things
the right to receive attention or action before others

ex.en: Finding a warm home is our main priority now.
ex.zh: 找到一个温暖的家是我们现在的首要任务。

ex.en: Governments should give priority to preventive healthcare rather than focus exclusively on treating existing illnesses.
ex.zh: 政府应优先重视预防性医疗，而不是只关注治疗已有疾病。

tip: give priority to后接优先考虑的事物。

senses.en: A place where people are kept as punishment for crimes.
The state of being kept in a prison.

ex.en: The old prison has become a popular local museum.
ex.zh: 这座旧监狱已成为当地一处受欢迎的博物馆。

ex.en: Education programmes in prison can help individuals develop skills that support their successful return to society.
ex.zh: 监狱内的教育项目能帮助服刑人员培养技能，支持他们顺利回归社会。

tip: in prison指服刑；in the prison强调在监狱内。

senses.en: A special right or advantage available only to certain people.
An opportunity to do something regarded as a special honour.

ex.en: Having the whole garden to myself felt like a privilege.
ex.zh: 能独自享用整个花园，感觉像是获得了特殊待遇。

ex.en: Access to quality education should be a universal right rather than a privilege reserved for wealthy families.
ex.zh: 获得优质教育应是人人享有的权利，而不是富裕家庭独享的特权。

tip: 表示荣幸常用have the privilege of doing。

senses.en: A high level of skill or ability in something.

ex.en: Her proficiency in French helped us order dinner easily.
ex.zh: 她熟练掌握法语，让我们轻松点好了晚餐。

ex.en: Universities often require evidence of English proficiency to ensure students can participate fully in academic discussions.
ex.zh: 大学通常要求提供英语能力证明，以确保学生能够充分参与学术讨论。

col: proficiency in English｜英语熟练程度
tip: 常用proficiency in接语言、学科或技能。

senses.en: The outline of a face or object seen from the side.
A short description of someone's life, work, or characteristics.
The amount of public attention someone or something receives.

ex.en: She drew her grandfather's profile with a soft pencil.
ex.zh: 她用软铅笔画出了祖父的侧面轮廓。

ex.en: Public exhibitions can raise the profile of local artists and attract visitors to smaller towns.
ex.zh: 公共展览能提高当地艺术家的知名度，并吸引游客前往小城镇。

col: raise the profile of｜提高……的知名度
keep a low profile｜保持低调
tip: in profile指呈侧面；a high profile指高关注度。

senses.en: Ordinary written language, rather than poetry

ex.en: Her clear prose makes this book easy to enjoy.
ex.zh: 她清晰流畅的文笔让这本书读起来轻松愉快。

ex.en: Reading well-crafted prose can help students develop a wider vocabulary and express complex ideas more clearly.
ex.zh: 阅读精心写就的散文可以帮助学生扩大词汇量，更清晰地表达复杂观点。

tip: 不可数；不限于文学散文，也包括小说等非韵文。

senses.en: The scientific study of the mind and behaviour.
The characteristic ways a person or group thinks and behaves.

ex.en: My sister studies psychology and hopes to help children.
ex.zh: 我姐姐学习心理学，希望将来帮助儿童。

ex.en: Research in psychology suggests that regular social interaction can support emotional wellbeing among older adults.
ex.zh: 心理学研究表明，经常进行社交互动有助于维护老年人的情绪健康。

tip: 开头的p不发音；psychologist指心理学家。

senses.en: A small amount of air, smoke, or steam released suddenly.
To breathe quickly and noisily after physical effort.
To release air or smoke, or swell with air.

ex.en: A puff of steam escaped from the kettle.
ex.zh: 一小团蒸汽从水壶里冒了出来。

ex.en: Older buses release puffs of dark smoke, highlighting the need for cleaner public transport in cities.
ex.zh: 老旧公交车排出一团团黑烟，凸显了城市发展更清洁公共交通的必要性。

col: puff out your cheeks｜鼓起腮帮子
tip: 一团烟用a puff of smoke；puff也可表示喘粗气。

senses.en: to obtain something by paying money for it
the act of buying something, or the thing bought

ex.en: You can purchase fresh bread at the corner shop.
ex.zh: 你可以在街角的小店买到新鲜面包。

ex.en: Consumers should consider repair costs and energy efficiency before they purchase new household appliances.
ex.zh: 消费者购买新家电前，应考虑维修成本和能源效率。

tip: purchase比buy正式；名词可指购买行为或买到的东西。

senses.en: a small money holder; in American English, a handbag
money available to a person, organisation, or government
to press your lips together into a small rounded shape

ex.en: She opened her purse and took out a coin.
ex.zh: 她打开零钱包，取出一枚硬币。

ex.en: Investment in preventive healthcare could reduce the long-term burden on the public purse.
ex.zh: 投资预防性医疗可以减轻公共财政的长期负担。

tip: 英式purse多指零钱包，美式常指女式手提包。

senses.en: having the training, skills, or experience needed for something
not complete or unconditional; involving limits or reservations

ex.en: Only a qualified electrician should repair that damaged socket.
ex.zh: 只有具备资质的电工才应该修理那个损坏的插座。

ex.en: Governments should invest in teacher training to ensure that every school has enough qualified staff.
ex.zh: 政府应投入资金培训教师，确保每所学校都有足够的合格教职人员。

col: qualified for the job｜能胜任这份工作
tip: qualified for＋名词；qualified to do表示有资格做。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: A radioactive metallic chemical element

ex.en: We learned about radium during our science lesson today.
ex.zh: 今天的科学课上，我们学习了有关镭的知识。

ex.en: The discovery of radium advanced scientific understanding of radioactivity, although its health risks were initially underestimated.
ex.zh: 镭的发现推动了科学界对放射性的认识，但其健康风险起初被低估了。

tip: radium是不可数名词，元素符号为Ra。

senses.en: Chosen or happening without a fixed pattern or deliberate plan.

ex.en: I opened the cookbook at a random page.
ex.zh: 我随手翻开了食谱中的一页。

ex.en: Researchers selected a random sample of households to assess public attitudes towards renewable energy.
ex.zh: 研究人员随机抽取了一些家庭，以评估公众对可再生能源的态度。

tip: random是形容词；作状语用randomly或at random。

senses.en: A position within an ordered system of importance or authority
To place or be placed in order of quality or importance
A line of people or things arranged side by side

ex.en: After years of service, she reached the rank of captain.
ex.zh: 服役多年后，她晋升为上尉。

ex.en: International surveys often rank cities according to housing affordability, public transport, and the quality of healthcare.
ex.zh: 国际调查常根据住房可负担性、公共交通和医疗质量对城市进行排名。

col: hold the rank of｜拥有……军衔
rank among the best｜跻身最优秀之列
in order of rank｜按等级顺序
tip: rank可作名词或动词；ranking常指排名或榜单。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.zh: n.逼真;现实主义;务实作风

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.zh: 现实主义艺术家（或作家等）；现实主义者

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Based on what is actually possible or likely
Looking or sounding very much like real life

ex.en: Finishing this puzzle tonight is not a realistic goal.
ex.zh: 今晚完成这幅拼图不是一个现实的目标。

ex.en: Governments should set realistic targets for reducing emissions, taking economic conditions and available technology into account.
ex.zh: 政府应考虑经济状况和现有技术，为减排制定切实可行的目标。

col: set realistic goals｜制定切实可行的目标
tip: realistic强调符合现实或逼真，real强调真实存在。

senses.en: a document showing that something has been paid for
the act of receiving something
money received by a business or organisation

ex.en: Keep your receipt in case the shoes don't fit.
ex.zh: 留好收据，以防鞋子不合脚。

ex.en: Businesses should issue a receipt for every purchase to protect consumers and maintain accurate financial records.
ex.zh: 商家应为每笔购买开具收据，以保护消费者并保留准确的财务记录。

tip: p不发音；表示收入时通常用复数receipts。

senses.en: Someone who welcomes visitors and handles enquiries at a reception desk.

ex.en: The receptionist smiled and handed us our room keys.
ex.zh: 接待员微笑着把房间钥匙递给了我们。

ex.en: A skilled receptionist can improve patients' experiences by managing appointments efficiently and responding calmly to enquiries.
ex.zh: 熟练的接待员能够高效安排预约、沉着回应咨询，从而改善患者的就诊体验。

col: work as a receptionist｜担任接待员
tip: reception 是接待处；receptionist 是接待员。

senses.en: Say a poem or passage aloud, often from memory
Say a series of facts or details aloud

ex.en: My sister recited a short poem after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我妹妹背诵了一首短诗。

ex.en: Students who merely recite facts may struggle to apply their knowledge to unfamiliar problems.
ex.zh: 只会背诵事实的学生可能难以运用知识解决陌生的问题。

col: recite a list｜逐一念出清单
tip: recite强调出声背诵；memorise强调记住。

senses.en: The act of identifying someone or something encountered before.
Public appreciation of someone's achievements or value.
Acceptance that something exists, is true, or has official status.

ex.en: His face lit up with recognition when I waved.
ex.zh: 我挥手时，他认出了我，脸上顿时露出喜色。

ex.en: Greater recognition of unpaid care work could lead to fairer social policies and stronger support for families.
ex.zh: 更加认可无偿照护工作的价值，可以推动更公平的社会政策，并加强对家庭的支持。

col: in recognition of｜为表彰；为肯定
tip: 通常不可数；in recognition of常用于表彰贡献。

senses.en: Activities done for enjoyment and relaxation when not working.

ex.en: I swim for recreation at the local leisure centre.
ex.zh: 我在当地休闲中心游泳消遣。

ex.en: Access to green spaces encourages outdoor recreation and can improve both physical health and mental wellbeing.
ex.zh: 能够方便地使用绿地有助于鼓励户外休闲活动，并可改善身心健康。

tip: 表示休闲娱乐通常不可数；别与re-creation重新创造混淆。

senses.en: To make someone feel less tired or more comfortable.
To load the latest version of displayed information.
To help someone remember something learned or experienced before.

ex.en: A cool shower refreshed me after the long walk.
ex.zh: 走了很远的路后，冲个凉让我恢复了精神。

ex.en: Regular breaks can refresh employees and help them maintain concentration during tasks that require sustained mental effort.
ex.zh: 定时休息能让员工恢复精神，帮助他们在需要持续脑力投入的任务中保持专注。

tip: 人感觉精神恢复用refreshed；令人清爽用refreshing。

senses.en: An official rule controlling how something must be done.
The process of controlling an activity or maintaining a condition.

ex.en: Safety regulations require everyone here to wear a helmet.
ex.zh: 安全规定要求这里的每个人都戴头盔。

ex.en: Stricter regulation of industrial waste could reduce water pollution and improve public health in nearby communities.
ex.zh: 加强对工业废物的监管可以减少水污染，并改善附近社区的公众健康。

tip: 具体条例可数；表示监管这一过程时通常不可数。

senses.en: To let someone or something go free or escape.
To make information or a product available to the public.
The act of freeing or publishing; something newly made available.

ex.en: We released the butterfly outside after checking its wings.
ex.zh: 检查过蝴蝶的翅膀后，我们把它放到了室外。

ex.en: Governments should release reliable environmental data so that citizens can evaluate the effectiveness of climate policies.
ex.zh: 政府应公布可靠的环境数据，让公民能够评估气候政策的成效。

tip: release可指释放，也可指公开发布报告或产品。

senses.en: to need someone's help or depend on something
to trust someone or something to act as expected

ex.en: I rely on my bicycle to get to work.
ex.zh: 我靠自行车通勤。

ex.en: Communities that rely heavily on tourism may face economic difficulties when visitor numbers suddenly decline.
ex.zh: 高度依赖旅游业的社区，在游客数量骤降时可能面临经济困难。

col: rely on someone to do something｜指望某人做某事
tip: 不直接接宾语：用rely on或rely upon。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.zh: 雷诺阿(法国印象派画家)

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Many times, often with little time between occasions.

ex.en: He knocked repeatedly, but nobody came to the door.
ex.zh: 他敲了好几次门，但没人来开门。

ex.en: Students who repeatedly practise retrieving information tend to remember it better than those who simply reread their notes.
ex.zh: 反复练习回忆信息的学生，通常比只是重读笔记的学生记得更牢。

tip: 强调次数多；不一定像regularly那样有规律。

senses.en: someone chosen to speak or act for other people
showing the usual features of a larger group

ex.en: Our class representative asked for more books in the library.
ex.zh: 我们班的代表请求为图书馆增添书籍。

ex.en: Researchers need a representative sample to draw reliable conclusions about the wider population.
ex.zh: 研究人员需要具有代表性的样本，才能对更广泛的人群得出可靠结论。

col: a representative sample｜有代表性的样本
tip: 形容词常接of：representative of某群体。

senses.en: The general opinion people have about someone or something.

ex.en: This little bakery has a reputation for excellent bread.
ex.zh: 这家小面包店以出色的面包闻名。

ex.en: Companies that respond honestly to customer complaints are more likely to maintain a good reputation.
ex.zh: 诚实回应顾客投诉的企业更有可能保持良好的声誉。

col: damage someone's reputation｜损害某人的声誉
a reputation for quality｜品质优良的口碑
tip: 用reputation for接特点；名声可好可坏。

senses.en: To officially leave a job or position.

senses.zh: 使自己接受不如意的事
senses.en: To accept an unpleasant situation because you cannot change it.

ex.en: She decided to resign and open a small bakery.
ex.zh: 她决定辞职，开一家小面包店。

ex.en: Employees may resign when excessive workloads and limited career opportunities make their positions increasingly difficult to sustain.
ex.zh: 当工作量过大、职业发展机会有限，使岗位越来越难以维持时，员工可能会辞职。

col: resign from a job｜辞去工作
resign as chair｜辞去主席职务
tip: resign oneself to后接名词或动名词，表示无奈接受。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: To find a satisfactory solution to a problem or disagreement.
To decide firmly to do something.
Strong determination to achieve something.

ex.en: We resolved the argument by taking turns cooking dinner.
ex.zh: 我们通过轮流做晚饭解决了这场争执。

ex.en: International cooperation is essential to resolve disputes over shared water resources and prevent future conflicts.
ex.zh: 国际合作对于解决共享水资源争端和预防未来冲突至关重要。

col: resolve to do something｜决心做某事
strengthen someone's resolve｜坚定某人的决心
tip: resolve a problem是解决；resolve to do是决心做。

senses.en: Belonging separately to each person or thing already mentioned.

ex.en: After dinner, the children returned to their respective rooms.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，孩子们各自回了自己的房间。

ex.en: Schools and families should understand their respective responsibilities in supporting children's emotional development and academic progress.
ex.zh: 学校和家庭应了解各自在支持儿童情感发展和学业进步方面的责任。

tip: 通常放在复数名词前；勿与respectful混淆。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: To bring back a previous condition, ability, or situation.
To repair something old or damaged to its earlier condition.
To return something to its rightful owner or place.

ex.en: The engineers restored power before our food went bad.
ex.zh: 工程师们在我们的食物变质之前恢复了供电。

ex.en: Planting native trees can help restore damaged ecosystems and provide essential habitats for local wildlife.
ex.zh: 种植本土树木有助于修复受损的生态系统，并为当地野生动物提供必要的栖息地。

col: restore a historic building｜修复历史建筑
restore something to its owner｜将某物归还原主
tip: restore A to B：使A恢复到B状态或归还给B。

senses.en: to limit what someone can do or how much is allowed

ex.en: These tight shoes restrict my movement when I dance.
ex.zh: 这双鞋太紧，跳舞时让我施展不开。

ex.en: Local authorities may restrict private vehicle access to city centres in order to reduce air pollution.
ex.zh: 地方政府可能限制私家车进入市中心，以减少空气污染。

col: restrict something to｜将某事物限定于
tip: restrict A to B表示“把A限定在B范围内”。

senses.en: a rule or condition that limits what is allowed

ex.en: There is a parking restriction outside our building today.
ex.zh: 今天我们楼外有停车限制。

ex.en: Restrictions on private car use may encourage commuters to choose more sustainable forms of transport.
ex.zh: 限制私家车使用可能会鼓励通勤者选择更可持续的交通方式。

tip: 对某事的限制用restriction on；具体规定常用复数。

senses.en: To start again after stopping or being interrupted.

ex.en: We will resume our walk when the rain stops.
ex.zh: 雨停后，我们会继续散步。

ex.en: Schools can resume normal teaching once damaged buildings have been repaired and essential safety checks are complete.
ex.zh: 受损建筑修复且必要的安全检查完成后，学校便可恢复正常教学。

col: resume normal service｜恢复正常服务
tip: 后接名词或动名词；名词résumé意为简历。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Something received for good work, helpful behaviour, or achievement.
To give something to someone for their efforts or help.

ex.en: We gave the puppy a treat as a reward.
ex.zh: 我们给了小狗一块零食作为奖励。

ex.en: Schools should reward consistent effort rather than focus exclusively on students who achieve the highest grades.
ex.zh: 学校应奖励持续的努力，而不是只关注成绩最好的学生。

col: reward someone for something｜因某事奖励某人
tip: reward强调付出后的回报；award常指正式授奖。

senses.zh: 押韵词；押韵的短诗；使）押韵

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.zh: 节奏；韵律；规律(；罗伯特·布朗宁（英国诗人

tip: 教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第三册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Extremely silly or unreasonable and deserving to be laughed at.

ex.en: This tiny sandwich costs a ridiculous amount of money.
ex.zh: 这么小的三明治，价格却贵得离谱。

ex.en: It is ridiculous to expect public transport use to increase without improving the reliability of existing services.
ex.zh: 不提高现有服务的可靠性，却指望公共交通使用量增加，这是荒谬的。

tip: 语气较强，强调荒唐不合理，不只是有趣。
教材补充词；首次出现于高三，来源：选择性必修第四册。
note: 教材补充词条：中文释义来自教材词汇表；发音使用设备语音。

senses.en: Fully grown and ready to eat or harvest
Ready for a particular action or development

ex.en: These ripe peaches smell wonderful and taste very sweet.
ex.zh: 这些熟桃子闻起来很香，吃起来很甜。

ex.en: With public support growing, the time is ripe for governments to invest more in renewable energy.
ex.zh: 随着公众支持度上升，政府加大可再生能源投资的时机已经成熟。

col: ripe for change｜变革时机成熟的
the time is ripe｜时机已经成熟
tip: 水果成熟用ripe；人心智成熟通常用mature。

senses.en: Relating to a king, queen, or their family.
A member of a royal family.

ex.en: We visited the royal palace during our holiday.
ex.zh: 我们度假时参观了王宫。

ex.en: Some royal residences are open to visitors, generating income that helps preserve historic buildings.
ex.zh: 一些王室住所向游客开放，所得收入有助于保护历史建筑。

tip: royal指王室的；loyal指忠诚的，注意首字母。

senses.en: an elastic material used to make tyres and other products
a small object used to remove pencil marks

ex.en: These rubber boots keep my feet dry in puddles.
ex.zh: 这双橡胶靴让我踩水坑时双脚也不会湿。

ex.en: Recycling rubber from used tyres can reduce waste and provide material for safer playground surfaces.
ex.zh: 回收废旧轮胎中的橡胶可以减少废物，并为更安全的游乐场地面提供材料。

tip: 橡胶不可数；橡皮擦可数，美式英语通常用eraser。
